steps: Map request details to a new phone aggregate and normalize currency text.
Run the phone policy; no hardware or money rules are added by this flow.
If phone validation fails, throw validation_failed before staging current or history rows.
Stage the new phone in EF; this does not commit it.
Build the first history snapshot with operation Inserted and the phone change time.
Stage the Inserted history row in the same EF context as the phone.
Save current and history together; a successful SQL save commits both, while a thrown save does not return success.
Map the saved phone to details; the endpoint returns 201 and its relative Location.
